scope: Prescribed voltage and initial motion; production physical integrator without sensors, observer or regulator feedback

mechanical_properties.collision_scope: Exact bottom-film cylinder against a local infinite plane at the CAD playing-surface height; convex exterior mesh for the king. Board edges and concave piece-to-piece contact remain unqualified.
mechanical_properties.friction_scope: Single Coulomb coefficient from resting_friction_coefficient; separate static/kinetic friction and torsional/rolling resistance remain unqualified.
mechanical_properties.damping_scope: Soft-contact numerical damping only. No artificial airborne joint damping or material vibration model.

limitations: Two-millisecond moving fragments with a fixed physical coil window; no handoff or full-move qualification.
Initial currents and holding voltage are calculated once and reused unchanged for both refinements.
Alternating voltage offsets use the existing current-transient allowance; these are a diagnostic stimulus, not PWM modeling.
Ideal analogue Hall filter starts at equilibrium; no sensor noise, calibration mismatch or ADC feedback.
Position, orientation and current use existing convergence limits; velocity, force/torque and analogue-field changes are reported without new acceptance budgets.
